# Giant Ancestry: Fire's Burn (`traits:giant-ancestry-fires-burn`)
**Species:** [Goliath](../species/goliath.md) | **Subspecies:** [Giant Ancestry: Fire's Burn](../subspecies/giant-ancestry-fires-burn.md)

When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.
